# Fixture-only personal capture -> review -> editor -> retrieval loop.
exec pinax init vault --title Daily --json
exec sh -c 'pinax inbox capture "Reading fragment" --slug fragment --stdin --vault vault --json < body.md'
stdout '"readback_status":"verified"'
exec sh -c 'pinax note add "Compiled note" --dir index --slug compiled --stdin --vault vault --json < body.md'
stdout '"readback_status":"verified"'
exists vault/notes/index/compiled.md

vault-digest vault before.sha
exec pinax inbox review --vault vault --json
stdout '"total":"2"'
stdout '"writes":"false"'
exec pinax inbox review --limit 1 --vault vault --agent
stdout 'fact.returned=1'
exec pinax search show compiled --vault vault --json
stdout '"name":"open"'
exec pinax note preview compiled --vault vault
stdout 'original-word'
exec pinax note attachments compiled --vault vault --json
exec pinax note links compiled --vault vault --json
stdout 'Missing source'
! exec pinax note open compiled --editor missing-daily-editor-executable --vault vault --json
stdout 'editor_failed'
vault-digest vault after.sha
cmp before.sha after.sha

# Editor edits only source body; subsequent native search sees it immediately.
exec pinax note open compiled --editor 'sh editor.sh' --vault vault --json
stdout '"status":"success"'
exec pinax search editor-added-marker --engine native --lazy-index off --vault vault --agent
stdout 'compiled.md'
exec pinax note show compiled --display body --vault vault --json
stdout 'editor-added-marker'
stdout 'original-word'

# Explicit previews do not become records or alter source content.
vault-digest vault preview-before.sha
exec sh -c 'pinax inbox capture "No write" --slug no-write --stdin --dry-run --vault vault --json < body.md'
! exec sh -c 'pinax inbox capture "Conflict" --stdin --body other --vault vault --json < body.md'
stdout 'note_source_conflict'
vault-digest vault preview-after.sha
cmp preview-before.sha preview-after.sha

# A broken/missing index has a native read fallback, with no rebuild on read.
rm vault/.pinax/index.sqlite
vault-digest vault fallback-before.sha
exec pinax search editor-added-marker --lazy-index off --vault vault --agent
stdout 'fact.engine=native'
stdout 'compiled.md'
exec pinax inbox review --vault vault --json
stdout '"total":"2"'
vault-digest vault fallback-after.sha
cmp fallback-before.sha fallback-after.sha

-- body.md --
# 中文资料

original-word：保留这段原文、来源和格式。

```go
fmt.Println("original")
```

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 阅读 | 完成 |

[来源](https://example.org/source)
[[Missing source]]
![Missing image](missing.png)

-- editor.sh --
printf '\neditor-added-marker\n' >> "$1"
